# are public. `word` is the shipped `ZONES` table read through one of its
# aliases; `offset` is `parseOffsetZone` on a written offset. They share a file
# because they share an answer — the zone id — and `zoneSymbol` is asked of both.
# `length` is how much of the input the offset parser claimed, and it is a
# column rather than a detail: the matcher that calls this splices the rest of
# the sentence back, so `gmt+3 meeting` claiming 5 and not 13 is the contract.
# Words claim nothing, so their length is `-`.
# `-` in the zone column is a refusal. `gmt` alone is one: with no sign it is
# the UTC alias the row above already covers, and reading it here would make
